title: Craft's power system explained aboard, like a submarine

tellings.quote: apparently when I was uh on board this craft inquired about their uh power system, you know, cuz I was curious about it and it was relayed to me that it works like the submarine working with a bubble of air.
it operates in a similar fashion to the way a submarine can work at different atmospheres in the water
tellings.difference: Calls it gravitational-field propulsion working at different 'atmospheres', where the story's teller compares it to a bubble of air.
tellings.link_reason: Same account: Charlie asked aboard the craft about its power system and was told it works like a submarine.

as_told.title: Beings explain gravitational-field propulsion like a submarine

plain: Charlie Foltz, who says he was taken aboard a craft near Eagle Lake, Maine, in 1976, tells Michels that while on board he asked his captors about the craft's power system. He says it was "relayed to me" that it works like a submarine working with a bubble of air. In another passage he puts it a little differently, saying the craft runs on a gravitational field and operates the way a submarine can work at different pressures in the water.
